spans.s:
औदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Watery, aquatic, of or belonging to water. E.
उदक, and ठञ् aff.

औदनिक m. (-कः) A cook.
 E. ओदन boiled rice, and ठक् aff.

औदरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Selfishly voracious.
 E. उदर the belly, and
ठक् aff.

औदश्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made of buttermilk, &c.
 n. (-तं) Buttermilk
with an equal proportion of water.
 E. उदश्वित् the same, and अण्
affix; or with कस् added औदश्वित्क.

औदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Magnanimity, generosity, greatness.
 E. उदार liberal,
and ष्यञ् aff.

औदास्य n. (-स्यं) Philosophy, stoicism, indifference.
 E. उदास, and ष्यञ् aff.

औद्दालक n. (-कं) A bitter and acrid substance like honey, said to be
found in the nest of the white ant.
